title: 扇形の落葉レーキ
description: 公園や庭園の落葉清掃場面向けの扇形レーキ。17本の厚み付きばね鋼風の爪と曲げ先端、横方向の保持線、クランプ、木色の長柄と握りを造形。爪は実ジオメトリで、画像テクスチャではありません。立て置き表示用で、道具掛けなどの支持はシーン側で追加してください。弾性変形や掃き集め動作はありません。 ゲーム・可視化向け。製造・構造設計・3Dプリント用途は未検証。 外接寸法（X×Y×Z）0.578 × 1.434 × 0.103 m、6,108三角形。単位m・Y-up、水平中央の接地用原点、最下点Y=0。部品ごとの重複UV0と単色PBR材質を収録し、画像テクスチャ・UV2・コライダー・LOD・リグ・動作は付属しません。静的表示用でUnity/VRChat実機検証は未実施。STLはm・Y-up座標の形状のみで色・材質・UV・階層を含みません。
descriptionEn: A fan rake for leaf-clearing scenes in parks and gardens, with 17 solid spring-steel-like tines and bent tips, transverse retainer, clamp, long wood-colored shaft and grip. The tines are modeled geometry, not a texture. Presented upright; add a rack or other support in the host scene. Elastic bending and raking behavior are absent. For games and visualization; not validated for manufacture, structural engineering or 3D printing. Bounding dimensions (X×Y×Z): 0.578 × 1.434 × 0.103 m; 6,108 triangles. Metres, Y-up, horizontally centered placement origin with minimum Y=0, not an articulation or wall-mount pivot. Includes overlapping component UV0 and constant-color PBR materials, with no image textures, unique UV2, colliders, LOD, rig or runtime behavior. Static visualization only; Unity/VRChat editor and runtime tests have not been performed. STL uses metre-valued Y-up coordinates and contains geometry only, without color, materials, UVs or hierarchy.
author: Xenoah
uv: Per-component primitive or automatically unwrapped UVs. Overlapping between components; not a packed unique lightmap atlas. Solid-color PBR materials; no external textures. STL has no colors or UVs.
